question: Which of the following glands in human beings secretes more than three hormones?
solution:
**__Explanation:__**

**Pituitary gland:** It is a small pea-sized gland. It is often called the master gland as it controls several other hormone glands in our body. It is located in the brain between Hypothalamus and the Pineal gland.

__
 
• 
 **Hormones produced by the pituitary gland**

 
 
 
• Adrenocorticotrophic hormone (ACTH)
 
• Thyroid-stimulating hormone (TSH)
 
• Luteinising hormone (LH)
 
• Follicle-stimulating hormone (FSH)
 
• Prolactin (PRL)
 
• Growth hormone (GH)
 
• Melanocyte-stimulating hormone (MSH)
 
 
 

So, the **pituitary gland** in human beings **secretes more than three hormones.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
 

 
 
Gland

 
 
 
Description

 
 
 

 
 
Thymus

 
 
 
Located between the Lungs.

 
Thymosin is the hormone of the thymus.

 
 
 

 
 
Adrenal

 
 
 
The adrenal gland is an endocrine gland that secretes the Adrenalin hormone. 

 
 
 

 Pancreas
 
 
Works as both endocrine and exocrine.

 
It works as an exocrine when it secretes pancreatic juice.

 
It works as an endocrine when it secretes hormones, insulin, or Glucagon to control blood sugar levels.

 
 
 

 
 
Thyroid

 
 
 
The thyroid gland is an endocrine gland located in the neck.

 The thyroid gland secretes three hormones, namely the two thyroid hormones (thyroxine/T4 and triiodothyronine/T3), and calcitonin.

 
 
 

 
 
Pineal

 
 
 
It is located in the epithalamus, near the centre of the brain.

 
The shape of the gland resembles a pine cone from which it derived its name.

 
The smallest gland in the human body.
